name: Execute Command
label: Sandbox argv (default off)
description: Runs an allowlisted argv list inside the node-library container (Podman sandbox). Never the daemon host. Never a shell. Default off — set enabled=true. Empty allowlist is refused. Working directory is confined to the sandbox workspace. A non-zero exit code is a normal result.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One exec. argv is the argument list (argv[0] must be allowlisted). Never a shell string. Example: ["echo","hello"].

schema.label: argv
schema.description: Purpose: argument vector passed to ProcessBuilder. argv[0] is the executable basename (or path whose basename is allowlisted). Never interpolated into a shell. Example: ["echo","hello"].

schema.label: stdin
schema.description: Purpose: optional UTF-8 bytes written to the child's stdin, then closed. Secrets must not be placed here from config.

schema.label: working_dir
schema.description: Purpose: workspace-relative cwd. Absolute paths and .. that leave the workspace are refused. Example: 'out'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`, `timed_out`). Non-zero exit_code is success of the node. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on success. EXACT value: 'ok'. Set even when exit_code is non-zero.

schema.label: exit_code
schema.description: Child exit status. -1 if the process was still alive after a timeout kill. Non-zero is a normal result.

schema.label: timed_out
schema.description: True when the wall-clock budget expired and the child was killed.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: exec. Required. Example: 'exec'.

configurationParameters.label: Enabled
configurationParameters.description: Master switch. Default false. The node refuses every invoke until this is true. Input cannot enable it.

configurationParameters.label: Allowlist
configurationParameters.description: JSON array (or comma list) of allowed executable basenames. Required. Empty list refuses. Example: '["echo","true"]'.

configurationParameters.label: Argv
configurationParameters.description: Argument vector. argv[0] must be on the allowlist. Example: ["echo","hello"]. INPUT wins.

configurationParameters.label: Stdin
configurationParameters.description: UTF-8 bytes written to the child stdin. INPUT wins.

configurationParameters.label: Working Dir
configurationParameters.description: Default workspace-relative cwd when input.working_dir is blank. Host paths rejected.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Fallback run budget in seconds when timeout_ms is blank/0. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 15s via timeout_ms default.
